title: Juz' Tabarak revision check: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Tajweed mastery and Al-Kahf consolidation
source: Written for quran/y11 lesson 9 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Juz' Tabarak revision check rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 9. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Revision to the summer
points: One surah of Juz' Tabarak a day

questions.q: Start at Al-Mulk 67:15 and recite three ayat.
Revision check: today's rota group recites a Juz' Tabarak surah to the teacher. Everyone else: 'start anywhere' in breakout pairs with the pupil PDF list.
questions.a: Rubric scores and targets recorded; partner list of starts and prompts.

questions.q: Extend: write your revision plan to the summer in the portal log.
Stretch: recite the first ayah of each surah 67 to 77.
Think again: Your final recitation assessment is in the summer. What would 'secure' look like for Juz' Tabarak by then?
questions.a: Recited from any starting point with sound tajweed, revised weekly on a rota.
